title: Nayi Karni Ghazi Ne Ghazi Ne Jang Zainab
body:
Nayi Karni Ghazi Ne Ghazi Ne Jang Zainab, Nayi Karni Ghazi Ne
Shabbir Ne Akheya Zainab Nu, Tenu Chadar Jaan Ton Pyaari Ay,
Ghazi Diyan Khairaan Mang Zainab,
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Shaam De Safar Te Jaan Velay, Ik Gal Da Khaas Khayal Rakheen,
Na Vekheen Sir Val Ghazi De, Na Gal Koyi Laash De Naal Kareen,
Edi Laash De Kolon Sir Nangay, Chup Kar Ke Javeen Lang Zainab,
Ghazi Diyan Khairaan Mang Zainab,
<<DIVIDER>>
Menu Aakheya Si Menu Das Mola, Tenu Keevain Veer Hussain Kawan,
Kinj Ho Sakda Eh Sain Meri, Zainab Nu Apni Bhen Kawan,
Mein Ummal Baneen Kaneez Da Chan, Oh Paak Batool Da Ang Zainab,
Ghazi Diyan Khairaan Mang Zainab,
<<DIVIDER>>
Menu Kenda Si Ay Jaan Velay, Mera Peer Hussain Ay Vada De,
Meri Laash Nayee Leh Jaway Ga, Bin Paani Kol Sakina De,
Ay Aakhri Gal Abbas Keeti, Geya Phir Chehray Da Rang Zainab,
Ghazi Diyan Khairaan Mang Zainab,
<<DIVIDER>>
Jera Kufa Vekh Ke Ayee Sain, Rut Badal Gayi Ohna Galiyan Di,
Oh Shaahi Si Teray Babay Di, Utoun Naal Hussain Da Ghazi Si,
Hun Kaleyaan Keevain Guzray Gi, Oh Mor Bazaar Ne Tang Zainab,
Ghazi Diyan Khairaan Mang Zainab,
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar Si Wasiyat Ghazi Di, Jadoun Poncho Vich Zindaan Tusi,
Pawain Zakhmi Hogayi Teeran Nal, Es Mashak De Vich Vi Jaan Meri,
Es Mashak Nu Vi Dafna Choray, Vich Qabr Sakina Sang Zainab,
Ghazi Diyan Khairaan Mang Zainab,
